plain: To settle a dispute by hearing both sides and deciding

webster.text: To hear and decide, as arbitrators; as, to choose men to arbitrate between us.

example.quote: Discussion and the general will arbitrates the question, and to this, private opinion yields with a good grace, and order is preserved uninterrupted.
example.cite: Thomas Paine, Rights of Man, Parts One and Two (London, 1791-92)
